title: NumPy Array Shape & Reshaping Visualizer
description: Step-by-step trace of creating a 12-element 1D array, querying .shape, transforming into a 3x4 2D matrix via .reshape(3, 4), inspecting new dimensional metadata (.ndim, .size), and accessing elements via coordinate indexing.

steps.explanation: Imports the numerical computing library NumPy with standard alias 'np'.
Allocates a contiguous 1D NumPy array with 12 temperature values.
Queries the .shape attribute. For a 1D vector of length 12, it returns the tuple (12,).
Calls readings.reshape(3, 4). Validates that 3 * 4 = 12 elements. Returns a new 2D matrix organized into 3 rows and 4 columns without altering raw values.
Queries the new array's .shape attribute, which returns (3, 4).
Queries table.ndim, which returns 2 (indicating 2 axes: rows and columns).
Performs coordinate indexing table[1, 2] (Row index 1, Column index 2). Accesses 30.
